technicalBlocker: Official TKGM parcel inquiry is public and supports geographic parcel display; local metropolitan viewer documents planning/buildings rather than parcel vectors. Native query schema/full polygon feature access and WUP-point sample were not verified. Direct city site request returned 403 from shell; official web content loads and describes the application, so this is an access limitation, not source absence.

officialSources.observation: Official TKGM directory lists Kahramanmaraş Kadastro Müdürlüğü under the Gaziantep regional directorate.
First-party TKGM page for the local Kahramanmaraş Cadastre Directorate.
